questions.comprehension_passage: Think Time : N.A Minimum Instruction Time : 0 SEARCH The figure shows a map with several locations on a grid where each tile is 1x1 in size. The locations are at grid points and are connected by either two-way edges (shown as undirected edges) or one- way edges (shown with one arrowhead). Take S as the start node and G as the goal node. The MoveGen function returns neighbours in alphabetical order. The RemoveSeen procedure removes neighbours already present in OPEN/CLOSED lists. Use Manhattan distance when needed [IMAGE: /data/images/cs3003_2022T3_Q1_AN.pdf cs3003_2022T3_Q1_FN_p4_Im1.webp|block] When we say a node is inspected/expanded/refined it means: the node is picked up from OPEN, and goal test is called, if goal test fails then MoveGen is called and, depending on the algorithm, the neighbours are selectively placed in OPEN.
